summary: Iteration 1. Backend: 23 pytest API checks (auth 401s, act-as limits, RBAC: dev can't create a CR (403), dev3 can't see a NAFED CR (404), PM can't create a System Admin (403), CR create/BA-approve/task/confirm/task transitions, SRN list/eligible/PDF+DOCX, approvals/UAT/bugs, dashboard/reports/audit/search, admin lists, Zoho not configured). 20 passed, 3 failed: unescaped regex and page=0 both return 500. UI (signed in as the test admin with a Clerk ticket, then act-as) was tested end to end: dashboard KPIs, act-as banner, BA Approve & assign dialog, New CR dialog, PM add task + confirm assignments, Komal's My Tasks and start/complete/SIT on the CR tasks tab, the 6-step SRN wizard, SRN detail with the SoD block reason for the author, PM approval from the Approvals queue, PDF/DOCX downloads, UAT board (UAT member gets action buttons), bug drawer, project list/detail tabs, report charts (6), and all admin tabs (user create, org tree with 12 nodes, Zoho 'Not connected' + Sync Now records a FAILED job, email outbox, audit, role policies). Refreshing keeps the session and sign-out returns to /sign-in. I fixed a mobile overflow on the dashboard and a stray dot in the wizard step pills.

minor.issue: 500. The user's q is passed straight into Mongo $regex without re.escape (routes_cr.py:126). The CR list search box will crash on input like '(' or '['.

500 for the same reason (routes_dash.py:127; global header search). The same pattern is in /api/audit action (routes_dash.py:120), /api/users q (routes_org.py:163), projects q (routes_org.py:284), and the module/screen duplicate-name checks (routes_org.py:386,420), where a name like 'Lot (v2)' gives wrong matches or an error.
500 because skip((page-1)*page_size) goes negative. Add Query(1, ge=1).

The email_messages record for the bug-fix SRN (srn_id 4451e93d…) has been stuck in status SENDING since 06:58 with attempts=1 and no sending_at field. The stale-recovery query filters on sending_at < stale, so records without sending_at are never recovered. Likely cause: the backend reloaded mid-send under older code. Fix: also match {sending_at: {$exists: false}} (or use created_at).

A follow-up email in the same thread gets 'Re: ' + the first thread subject. The SRN-2026-0002 TEST-V2 email's subject therefore reads '...SRN SRN-2026-0001 TEST-V1 deployed to UAT', and the recipient can't see which release it is from the subject.
Not admin-only: a developer gets 200 with emails for their own projects. Probably intended, but confirm.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: the mt-6 grid had no grid-cols-1, so truncated pending-action text pushed the column to ~555px (scrollWidth 571 > 390) and badges were clipped. Added grid-cols-1.
FIXED: completed steps showed '✓ . Select Project' (stray dot).

integration_issues.issue: The FAILED job is recorded and listed, but the user gets no toast or feedback when clicking.

The Module column is empty and the preview shows a blank 'Module Name' for CR-2026-0003, even though the CR has impacted module 'Auction Management'. impacted_modules is not prefilled from the selected CRs.

issues: These use the browser's native <input type=date> instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover date picker.
A CR in READY_FOR_UAT still highlights step 5 'SIT' as current, not done, while the badge says 'Ready For UAT'. This is confusing.
CR-2026-0001 shows 'Retest Passed · 0/1 cases passed' and only SRN-2026-0001. The FAIL case from the first round is counted, and the bug-fix SRN isn't shown.
Tasks of the CLOSED CR-2026-0001 still appear under 'Released to UAT' (the task status stays READY_FOR_UAT after the CR closes).
The act-as selector and global search are hidden below lg/md, so there is no act-as on mobile. Acceptable for demo mode.

rca of the issue: Search 500: the raw query string is used as a Mongo regex pattern, and invalid patterns raise OperationFailure, which is unhandled. Mobile overflow: CSS grid items default to min-width:auto, so a whitespace-nowrap truncate child widens the implicit auto column; grid-cols-1 (minmax(0,1fr)) fixes it. Stuck email: a record in SENDING without sending_at never matches the recovery filter.
